MIT RES.9-010 Brain and Cognitive Sciences Computational Tutorial: Optimizing the Full Stack for Generative Image and Video Models Fall 2025
Speaker: Sayak Paul

View the complete course: https://ocw.mit.edu/courses/res-9-010-bcs-tutorials-optimizing-the-full-stack-for-generative-image-and-video-models-fall-2025/

This tutorial covers optimization strategies for diffusion models used in image and video generation; topics include architecture design, hardware efficiency, and inference techniques.
